Where did you get them?''"<br />"''My husband&hellip; ''Andur''&hellip; gave them to me.|[[Vodo-Siosk Baas]] and [[Nomi Sunrider]]|<ref name="FNU1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Pontite crystal''' was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], and a member of the [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]] family. For millennia, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] used Adegan crystals, including pontite, as the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focusing crystal]] in their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="TotJC" /> Pontite was the rarest form of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]] and the most powerful when used in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] construction.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|37|pontites}}</ref>
